title: Chapter 261 The Fate Is Decided
content:
Chapter 261 The Fate Is Decided

In the deserted city.

Looking at Lu Daosheng in front of him, Lu Xue's heart beat faster.

Could it be that something happened that even my father couldn't solve?

She didn't forget the terrifying giant hand that appeared on the sky not long ago.

It's a little bit too late, it's a little bit too much for me to be in a state of depression.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng didn't know what Lu Xue was thinking.

At this time, the space moves slightly.

Yan Lingyun also walked slowly towards here from a distance.

"mother.."

"Spiritual rhyme."

The two looked at Yan Lingyun.

Yan Lingyun nodded slightly, then glanced at the presence.

The rest of the people also saluted Yan Lingyun respectfully.

"Madam of the City Lord."

"Master."

Because Lu Daosheng was in the same place, all the people present were from their deserted city.

Of course, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng, who were trembling in a corner of the square, were exceptional.

Because of Lu Xue's relationship, these two people were not sent out of the deserted city by Lu Daosheng.

At this moment, everyone was watching Lu Daosheng's family of three.

They also felt that something huge change seemed to happen next.

"But what happened?"

Yan Lingyun looked at Lu Daosheng and asked.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded slightly, "It's really something."

"Do you need my help?"

Yan Lingyun seemed to have guessed something at this moment.

However, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "This depends on what Xiaoxue said."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng turned his head and looked at Lu Xue.

"Xiaoxue, do you want to protect this world?"

Protect this world.

When Lu Xue heard this question, he was stunned.

"Me? Am I myself?"

Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly, "You can also find someone else, but you need to rely on your own abilities."

"Dad, where are you?"

Lu Xue seemed to have guessed something, and her expression was slightly depressed.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was a little silent.

He was hesitating, too.

Although my daughter does need to exercise, it is indeed a bit difficult to rely on herself to protect this world.

If you help yourself, then this matter is meaningless.

After all, as soon as I took action, everything was solved.

As long as he thinks, no one in the entire heaven and the world can stop him.

Seeing that his father was not talking, Lu Xue turned her head to look at Yan Lingyun.

Yan Lingyun noticed Lu Xue's gaze, and then touched Lu Xue's head.

"Xiaoxue, just say whatever you think."

“No matter what decision you make, we will support you.”

When Lu Xue heard his mother's words, he was moved.

Everyone in the surrounding deserted city also agreed.

Next, no matter what choice Lu Xue makes, the entire fairy world will undergo a drastic change.

Looking at the gazes of everyone around him, Lu Xue also began to ponder.

At this moment, she thought of the past.

At that time, she was just a wilderness, a trivial little person.

What she wants to do all day is to work hard to improve herself.

Let yourself and your dad live a better life.

At the same time, I was also fantasizing in my heart that one day I could rise up, spread the world and become famous in the world.

But later, happiness came so suddenly.

It made her a little overwhelmed.

For a long time, I was in a state of confusion.

The invincible father made her lose everything while losing her worries.

What should I do next?

No matter what you do, I am afraid that no one will be valued.

After all, my father is so dazzling.

So she just made a fuck.

Later, she wanted to go out and make a breakthrough.

Maybe it was a whim, and she wanted to prove herself.

"Dad, can I protect this world?"

After a long silence, Lu Xue finally spoke.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng covered up the excitement in his heart and said in a calm expression: "You still have to ask yourself this question. If you even think you can't do it, then others' words will be of no use."

"I think?"

Lu Xue murmured to herself.

Looking at her hands, she suddenly felt a little heavy at this moment.

Is this the feeling of responsibility?

"Dad, I want to give it a try."

In the end, Lu Xue made her own decision.

After wandering for so long, it’s time for me to do something meaningful.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng took a deep breath and said slowly, "Have you really made up your mind?"

"You have to know that this time it really depends on you. Not only will I not help you, but even your mother, including the entire wasteland city, will not help you. It is still too late to regret it now."

However, Lu Xue smiled bitterly.

"Dad, if you say it, I will really regret it."

Lu Daosheng's face stagnated and he hurriedly said, "Just make a decision, just make a decision."

My daughter is really promising.

On the side, Yan Lingyun also smiled and looked at Lu Xue with relief.

My daughter is indeed with me.

At this moment, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng looked at each other in a corner of the square.

What's going on?

Next, Sister Xue will protect the entire fairy world?

Who am I, where am I, what happened?

Several questions arose in the hearts of both of them.

But not to mention that they don’t know what happened, even Lu Xue himself doesn’t know.

Anyway, my dad said that, it was definitely not a joke.

"Dad, what happened?"

Lu Xue asked at this time.

Suddenly she was going to let her protect the fairy world. Even though she agreed, she still didn't react for a while.

My first thought was that my father wanted to test himself again?

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng's face also became serious.

Lu Daosheng slowly looked up at the sky.

"The fairy world is about to come."

"A great enemy?"

Lu Daosheng nodded, "With the current strength of the fairy world, let alone winning, it is difficult to protect yourself."

"Ah? I won't be alone, right?"

Lu Xue said guiltily.

If she really relied on her alone, she would have run away.

"You can also find a helper, of course, it depends on your own ability."

Hearing this, Lu Xue sighed and said, "Dad, what are you?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng coughed lightly and said, "We."

"Of course we won't be idle either. We will deal with the strongest group of strong men on the other side. How about it, Dad is that good enough?"

Lu Daosheng chuckled.

He said this correctly, and he would take action himself and stay in the starry sky.

In order to help the fairy world restrain it and give more world development.

Because the fairy world is really too weak now.

No matter what Lu Xue said, she is her own daughter, how could she do nothing?

Lu Xue also nodded with clarity.

"Dad, what would you do if you were me?"

Lu Xue smiled and asked immediately.

Hearing this question, Lu Daosheng was stunned.

"I?"
